_comment: Edit this file to tune auto-categorization. Re-run sort_exams.py any time after editing.

subject_overrides._comment: Map a Discord channel name to a nicer display subject name. Any channel not listed here uses its own name (title-cased). Example: "math101": "Mathematics 101"

channel_ignore_list_comment: Channel names to skip entirely (announcements, off-topic, etc.)

month_term_map._comment: Maps a message's month (from text or, as fallback, its timestamp) to a term/semester label. Edit the labels to match your institution's calendar.

exam_type_keywords._comment: First matching keyword (case-insensitive substring match against message text) wins. Add languages/aliases as needed.
